task: ae.aho: Aho-Corasick automaton with findAll, leftmost-longest replace, counts, streaming matcher and invariant checker
reasoning_summary: Built a trie with BFS failure and output links, sorted-array children and a shared step/emit core used by findAll, counts, leftmost-longest and the stream. Verified with literal classic answers, randomized brute-force differential tests (case folding, duplicates, random chunk splits), a corruption-detecting invariant checker and a 15-mutant hand mutation check.
